Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied Wien’s law by incorrectly ordering red and orange—stating red has a shorter wavelength (~610 nm) than orange (~630–640 nm). In reality, orange is shorter than red, so orange is hotter than red. This led to the wrong ranking (choosing Object 1, Object 2, Object 3 instead of Object 1, Object 3, Object 2) and a premature “TASK_COMPLETE” without verification.
